reviewerLabel: benchmark tool loop, auto:glm-5.2 through MultiLLM-Proxy

verdicts.label: e1
verdicts.reason: Six passing tests cover only some of the nine rules in the description. Evidence of tests covering ValueError cases for invalid quotes, newlines outside quoted fields, delimiter validation, field validation, and the round-trip property would convince me.

verdicts.label: e2
verdicts.reason: The md5sum has no reference hash to compare against, so it does not prove the file is unchanged, and the claim that tests pass is not backed by test-run output. A test run combined with a hash comparison against a known baseline would convince me.

gate.reason: 2 of 2 criteria are not proven (2 rejected).
